GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 332.1 (19 Dec 46) GA
(SCAPIN - 1413)
APO 500
19 December 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Hoisting of National Flag.
1. There is no objection to the display of the Japanese national flag on 1, 3 and 5 January 1947 as requested by C.L.O. No. 6629 (PHW) dated 13 December 1946.
2. Occupation troops will be informed in this matter.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
